Literary Structure

A literary map of Song of Songs follows the book as received before isolating verses. Trace changes of speaker, setting, genre, repeated vocabulary, conflict, and resolution; then test whether the proposed divisions illuminate human love, desire, covenant, allegory, Israel, Christ, and Church. A map is an interpretive aid rather than inspired chapter headings.
